quests.title: Sunset Above the Horizon
quests.description: Head to the highest viewpoint or hill near you. Sit quietly and watch the sun dip below the horizon without looking at your phone.

quests.title: 15-Minute Sky Gazing
quests.description: Find an open grassy spot or balcony. Lie down or lean back and watch the clouds float for 15 minutes straight. No phone allowed.

quests.title: Phone-Free Studio Ghibli Night
quests.description: Put your phone in another room or inside a drawer. Dim the lights, make tea, and watch a Studio Ghibli masterpiece uninterrupted.

quests.title: Reconnect across Time
quests.description: Reach out and voice call a friend you haven't spoken to in years. Ask them how life has been without any underlying agenda.

quests.title: Spreading Genuine Light
quests.description: Give genuine, heartfelt compliments to 5 strangers throughout your day (e.g. praising a jacket, smile, or local shopkeeper's service).

quests.title: Solo Sanctuary at a Local Café
quests.description: Pick a cozy independent café you've never visited. Order a hot drink, leave your phone face down, and read a physical book for 45 minutes.

quests.title: The Mystery Public Bus Route
quests.description: Hop on a local public bus line you've never ridden before. Ride it all the way to the final stop or a vibrant hub and spend 20 minutes walking around.

quests.title: Garimahina Summer Plunge
quests.description: It's warm outside! Find a natural lake, clean river spot, or local pool and go for an invigorating swim to shake off routine inertia.

quests.title: Jadamahina Elixir Craftsman
quests.description: It's cold out! Go to a market, buy raw spiced ingredients (cinnamon, cardamon, honey, milk or cocoa), and craft an artisanal hot potion from scratch.

quests.title: The Hidden Alleyway Walk
quests.description: Walk down a narrow historic alley or side street in your neighborhood that you always pass by but have never actually walked down.

quests.title: Documentary of a Quiet Place
quests.description: Go to a peaceful place alone (park bench, temple courtyards, riverside) and write down 5 distinct sensory observations in your journal.

quests.title: First-Time Local Bite
quests.description: Find a street food cart or small local eatery serving a dish you have never tasted before. Eat slowly and savor the unknown flavor.
